summary: Fixed Todo.__post_init__ to distinguish between 'not provided' timestamps and explicitly empty strings using a sentinel value. This preserves empty timestamps during round-trip (to_dict -> from_dict) while still auto-filling timestamps for new Todo instances.
risks_limitations: The sentinel value approach uses object identity check (is _UNSET) which works correctly with slots=True
from_dict now preserves empty strings explicitly, which may affect any code expecting auto-fill behavior

implementation_details.approach: Use a sentinel value (_UNSET) as the default for created_at/updated_at fields instead of empty string
implementation_details.key_change: __post_init__ now checks 'is _UNSET' instead of 'if not self.created_at'
implementation_details.from_dict_change: from_dict now preserves explicit empty strings and only uses sentinel for missing keys
